Maintiens Espace (ou le clic) pour charg: Hold Space (or click) to charge, release to jump · in expert mode, hold in the air to spin faster · P: pause
Plus tu maintiens, plus la bouteille sau: The longer you hold, the further and higher the bottle jumps: the white dots show the whole jump, up to the furniture where it lands. In the air, it spins by itself; hold to make it spin twice as fast. It must land upright on top of a piece of furniture, within 46°; almost straight is PERFECT and counts double. Jumping over a piece of furniture scores more. If it tips over or falls on the floor, you lose a bottle and start again from the same piece; if it lands back on the same piece, you can try again. Every 15 pieces of furniture, you move to another room: living room, kitchen, bedroom, garden. Two full turns in the air: DOUBLE (points ×2); three: TRIPLE (×3).
Le fantôme de la bouteille montre où ell: The ghost bottle shows where it will land and which way up: green, it will land upright; orange, hold to make it spin faster; red, it will miss. Three bottles per game.
Manette : A (ou B, RB, RT, croix haut) m: Gamepad: hold A (or B, RB, RT, d-pad up) to charge then to spin, Start to pause.
Rien n'est synchronisé : tes records res: Nothing is synced: your records stay on this device.
Un seul geste : maintiens pour viser, lâ: A single move: hold to aim, release to jump; the spin adjusts itself. Five tries, furniture closer together.
Tu règles aussi la rotation : maintiens: You also control the spin: hold in the air to spin faster. Three tries.
Jeu d'adresse : une bouteille d'eau saut: Skill game: a water bottle jumps from furniture to furniture, from the living room to the kitchen, the bedroom and the garden. Hold your finger to charge the jump, release to throw it, and hold in the air to make it spin faster: it must land upright. The ghost bottle shows where and which way up it will land. Three bottles per game, perfect flips in slow motion that count double, jumps over a piece of furniture and streaks. Fullscreen. Score and best. A one-move easy mode, four objects (bottle, can, book, phone), doubles and triples.
Maintiens le doigt sur le jeu pour charg: Hold your finger on the game to charge, release to jump · in expert mode, hold in the air to spin faster
